description: This file defines the ResourceOwnerInterface interface within the league/oauth2-client library, specifying methods to retrieve a resource owner's ID and details as an array.

classes.name: ResourceOwnerInterface
classes.description: An interface for classes representing a resource owner authenticated with a service provider, requiring methods to get an ID and convert owner details to an array.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the authorized resource owner.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all available owner details as an array.
